comment: States of the demo contest in which TestCMSTaskPages (tasks_test.go) compares the task, submission and user test pages with the original CMS. capture.py applies base + the scenario's sql to the reference CMS's database, logs in as user and saves what the pages answer (captured.json and the .html files); the test applies the same SQL to the demo dump. Placeholders: {NOW-<seconds>} and {NOW+<seconds>} are times relative to the capture, written as literals in captured.json. Digests are read from rows both databases have (CMS uses SHA-1, this fork SHA-256).
base: DELETE FROM submissions WHERE participation_id = (SELECT p.id FROM participations p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.username = 'carol')
DELETE FROM user_tests WHERE participation_id = (SELECT p.id FROM participations p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.username = 'carol')

UPDATE contests SET allow_questions = true, allow_user_tests = true, submissions_download_allowed = true, allow_unofficial_submission_before_analysis_mode = false, max_submission_number = NULL, max_user_test_number = NULL, min_submission_interval = NULL, min_user_test_interval = NULL, token_mode = 'finite', token_max_number = 10, token_min_interval = '0', token_gen_initial = 2, token_gen_number = 1, token_gen_interval = '30 seconds', token_gen_max = 5 WHERE name = 'demo'

UPDATE tasks SET token_mode = 'infinite', max_submission_number = NULL, max_user_test_number = NULL, min_submission_interval = NULL, min_user_test_interval = NULL, feedback_level = 'restricted' WHERE name IN ('sum', 'half')

UPDATE tasks SET token_mode = 'disabled', max_submission_number = NULL, max_user_test_number = NULL, min_submission_interval = NULL, min_user_test_interval = NULL, feedback_level = 'restricted' WHERE name = 'quiz'
UPDATE testcases SET public = (codename = '000') WHERE dataset_id = (SELECT active_dataset_id FROM tasks WHERE name = 'sum')
UPDATE testcases SET public = false WHERE dataset_id IN (SELECT active_dataset_id FROM tasks WHERE name IN ('half', 'quiz'))

UPDATE groups SET start = '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00', stop = '2030-01-01 00:00:00+00', analysis_enabled = false, analysis_start = '2030-01-01 00:00:00+00', analysis_stop = '2030-01-01 00:00:00+00', per_user_time = NULL
UPDATE participations SET starting_time = NULL, delay_time = '0', extra_time = '0', unrestricted = false, hidden = false, ip = NULL, password = 'plaintext:demo'

sql: UPDATE testcases SET public = (codename = '000') WHERE dataset_id = (SELECT active_dataset_id FROM tasks WHERE name = 'half')

INSERT INTO files (submission_id, filename, digest) SELECT s.id, t.name || '.%l', (SELECT f.digest FROM files f JOIN submissions s2 ON s2.id = f.submission_id WHERE s2.opaque_id = 4926046975063954292) FROM submissions s JOIN tasks t ON t.id = s.task_id WHERE s.opaque_id BETWEEN 1000000000000000001 AND 1000000000000000012

INSERT INTO files (submission_id, filename, digest) SELECT s.id, v.f, (SELECT a.digest FROM attachments a WHERE a.filename = v.a) FROM submissions s, (VALUES ('output_000.txt', 'input_000.txt'), ('output_001.txt', 'input_001.txt')) AS v(f, a) WHERE s.opaque_id = 1000000000000000021

INSERT INTO submission_results (submission_id, dataset_id, compilation_text, compilation_tries, compilation_stdout, compilation_stderr, compilation_time, compilation_wall_clock_time, compilation_memory, evaluation_tries) SELECT s.id, t.active_dataset_id, v.ct::text[], 1, v.so, v.se, v.tm, v.tm, v.mem, 1 FROM (VALUES (1000000000000000002, 'fail', '{"Compilation failed"}', 'checking <stdout> & co', 'sum.cpp:3: error: expected ''}''', 0.25, 2097152, NULL), (1000000000000000003, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', NULL, NULL, NULL), (1000000000000000004, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', NULL, NULL, 0.5, 1048576, 'ok'), (1000000000000000005, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', 0.5, 1048576, 'ok'), (1000000000000000006, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', 0.5, 1048576, 'ok'), (1000000000000000007, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', 0.5, 1048576, 'ok'), (1000000000000000011, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', 0.5, 1048576, 'ok'), (1000000000000000012, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', 0.5, 1048576, 'ok'), (1000000000000000021, 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'ok')) AS v(o, co, ct, so, se, tm, mem, eo) JOIN submissions s ON s.opaque_id = v.o JOIN tasks t ON t.id = s.task_id
UPDATE submission_results sr SET compilation_outcome = 'ok' FROM submissions s WHERE sr.submission_id = s.id AND s.opaque_id BETWEEN 1000000000000000003 AND 1000000000000000021
UPDATE submission_results sr SET compilation_outcome = 'fail' FROM submissions s WHERE sr.submission_id = s.id AND s.opaque_id = 1000000000000000002
UPDATE submission_results sr SET evaluation_outcome = 'ok' FROM submissions s WHERE sr.submission_id = s.id AND s.opaque_id BETWEEN 1000000000000000004 AND 1000000000000000021

UPDATE submission_results sr SET score = 60.0, score_details = '[{"idx": 0, "score_fraction": 0.0, "score": 0.0, "max_score": 40, "testcases": [{"idx": "000", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.012, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 1048576, "show_in_restricted_feedback": true, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": true}, {"idx": "001", "outcome": "Not correct", "text": ["Output isn''t correct"], "time": 0.5, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 2097152, "show_in_restricted_feedback": false, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": false}]}, {"idx": 1, "score_fraction": 1.0, "score": 60.0, "max_score": 60, "testcases": [{"idx": "002", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.25, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 3145728, "show_in_restricted_feedback": false, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": false}, {"idx": "003", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Execution timed out"], "time": 1.2, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": true, "memory": null, "show_in_restricted_feedback": false, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": false}]}]', public_score = 0.0, public_score_details = '[{"idx": 0, "testcases": [{"idx": "000", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.012, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 1048576, "show_in_restricted_feedback": true, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": true}, {"idx": "001"}]}, {"idx": 1, "testcases": [{"idx": "002"}, {"idx": "003"}]}]', ranking_score_details = ARRAY['0', '60'], scored_at = '2026-10-14 09:00:00+00' FROM submissions s WHERE sr.submission_id = s.id AND s.opaque_id IN (1000000000000000005, 1000000000000000007)

UPDATE submission_results sr SET score = 40.0, score_details = '[{"idx": 0, "score_fraction": 1.0, "score": 40.0, "max_score": 40, "testcases": [{"idx": "000", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.012, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 1048576, "show_in_restricted_feedback": true, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": true}, {"idx": "001", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.5, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 2097152, "show_in_restricted_feedback": false, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": false}]}, {"idx": 1, "score_fraction": 0.0, "score": 0.0, "max_score": 60, "testcases": [{"idx": "002", "outcome": "Not correct", "text": ["Output isn''t correct"], "time": 0.25, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 3145728, "show_in_restricted_feedback": false, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": false}, {"idx": "003", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.3, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 4194304, "show_in_restricted_feedback": false, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": false}]}]', public_score = 0.0, public_score_details = '[{"idx": 0, "testcases": [{"idx": "000", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.012, "time_limit": 1.0, "time_limit_was_exceeded": false, "memory": 1048576, "show_in_restricted_feedback": true, "show_in_oi_restricted_feedback": true}, {"idx": "001"}]}, {"idx": 1, "testcases": [{"idx": "002"}, {"idx": "003"}]}]', ranking_score_details = ARRAY['40', '0'], scored_at = '2026-10-14 09:00:00+00' FROM submissions s WHERE sr.submission_id = s.id AND s.opaque_id = 1000000000000000006

UPDATE submission_results sr SET score = v.score, score_details = '[{"idx": "000", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.01, "memory": 1048576}, {"idx": "001", "outcome": "Partially correct", "text": ["Output is partially correct"], "time": 0.02, "memory": 2097152}, {"idx": "002", "outcome": "Not correct", "text": ["Output isn''t correct"], "time": 0.03, "memory": null}]', public_score = 33.333333333333336, public_score_details = '[{"idx": "000", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": 0.01, "memory": 1048576}, {"idx": "001"}, {"idx": "002"}]', ranking_score_details = ARRAY['50'], scored_at = '2026-10-14 10:00:00+00' FROM submissions s, (VALUES (1000000000000000011, 50.0), (1000000000000000012, 75.5)) AS v(o, score) WHERE sr.submission_id = s.id AND s.opaque_id = v.o

UPDATE submission_results sr SET score = 50.0, score_details = '[{"idx": "000", "outcome": "Correct", "text": ["Output is correct"], "time": null, "memory": null}, {"idx": "001", "outcome": "Not correct", "text": ["Output isn''t correct"], "time": null, "memory": null}]', public_score = 0.0, public_score_details = '[{"idx": "000"}, {"idx": "001"}]', ranking_score_details = ARRAY['50'], scored_at = '2026-10-14 10:00:00+00' FROM submissions s WHERE sr.submission_id = s.id AND s.opaque_id = 1000000000000000021

sql: INSERT INTO user_tests (participation_id, task_id, timestamp, language, input) SELECT p.id, t.id, v.ts::timestamptz, v.lang, (SELECT a.digest FROM attachments a WHERE a.filename = 'input_000.txt') FROM (VALUES ('sum', '2026-10-14 08:00:00+00', 'C++17 / g++'), ('sum', '2026-10-14 08:10:00+00', 'C++17 / g++'), ('sum', '2026-10-14 08:20:00+00', 'C11 / gcc'), ('sum', '2026-10-14 08:30:00+00', 'Python 3 / CPython'), ('sum', '2026-10-14 08:40:00+00', 'C++17 / g++'), ('half', '2026-10-14 08:50:00+00', 'Java / JDK')) AS v(task, ts, lang) JOIN tasks t ON t.name = v.task JOIN participations p ON p.contest_id = t.contest_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.username = 'carol'

INSERT INTO user_test_files (user_test_id, filename, digest) SELECT ut.id, t.name || '.%l', (SELECT f.digest FROM files f JOIN submissions s2 ON s2.id = f.submission_id WHERE s2.opaque_id = 4926046975063954292) FROM user_tests ut JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ut.task_id JOIN participations p ON p.id = ut.participation_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.username = 'carol'

INSERT INTO user_test_results (user_test_id, dataset_id, output, compilation_outcome, compilation_text, compilation_tries, compilation_stdout, compilation_stderr, compilation_time, compilation_wall_clock_time, compilation_memory, evaluation_outcome, evaluation_text, evaluation_tries, execution_time, execution_wall_clock_time, execution_memory) SELECT ut.id, t.active_dataset_id, CASE WHEN v.out THEN (SELECT a.digest FROM attachments a WHERE a.filename = 'input_001.txt') END, v.co, v.ct::text[], 1, v.so, v.se, 0.75, 0.8, 3145728, v.eo, v.et::text[], 1, v.et2, v.et2, v.em FROM (VALUES ('2026-10-14 08:10:00+00', 'fail', '{"Compilation failed"}', 'warning <x>', 'error: & y', NULL, '{}', false, NULL::float8, NULL::bigint), ('2026-10-14 08:20:00+00', 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', NULL, '{}', false, NULL, NULL), ('2026-10-14 08:30:00+00', 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', '', '', 'ok', '{"Execution completed successfully"}', true, 0.125, 5242880), ('2026-10-14 08:40:00+00', 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', NULL, NULL, 'ok', '{"Execution timed out"}', false, NULL, NULL), ('2026-10-14 08:50:00+00', 'ok', '{"Compilation succeeded"}', 'x', NULL, 'ok', '{"Execution killed with signal %s", "11"}', true, 1.5, 268435456)) AS v(ts, co, ct, so, se, eo, et, out, et2, em) JOIN user_tests ut ON ut.timestamp = v.ts::timestamptz JOIN tasks t ON t.id = ut.task_id JOIN participations p ON p.id = ut.participation_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.username = 'carol'
